note.zh: 测=第三方实测；T=Token。长上下文从100%用至0%，控制台与请求日志交叉核对；缓存命中率不到60%。仅为该地区Go测试样本，非官方固定额度；模型、缓存、输出及思考档位会改变可用Token量。原文10月30日补充高缓存工作流可用量更高；不外推其他套餐或周月额度。
note.en: obs.=third-party observation; T=tokens. Long-context requests drained a full window from 100% to 0%, cross-checked against console and request logs; cache hit rate below 60%. Regional Go sample only, not a fixed official quota. Model, cache, output and reasoning affect usable tokens. The Oct 30 follow-up reports higher throughput with more caching. No extrapolation to other tiers or weekly/monthly caps.
